response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"Paul urgently and passionately declared the whole counsel of God","suggested_fix":"Replace «خدا کی پوری مرضی» with «خدا کا پورا مشورہ» (or another standard Urdu rendering of “the whole counsel of God”), preserving the distinction between God’s counsel and God’s will.","translation_quote":"پولس نے خدا کی پوری مرضی فوری طور پر اور جوش سے بیان کی"},{"location":"Paragraph 5","severity":"major","source_quote":"This passionate preaching stirs the conscience and convicts the heart.","suggested_fix":"Replace «دل کو قائل کرتی ہے» with wording that conveys conviction, such as «دل کو گناہ کا احساس دلاتی ہے»; the source says it convicts the heart, not merely persuades it.","translation_quote":"یہ پُرجوش منادی ضمیر کو بیدار کرتی اور دل کو قائل کرتی ہے۔"},{"location":"Paragraph 11","severity":"major","source_quote":"Conviction never lacks emotion.","suggested_fix":"Replace «قائل ہونے میں» with a phrase conveying conviction, such as «گناہ کا احساس دلانے میں» or «دلی ملامت میں», so the sentence concerns conviction rather than persuasion.","translation_quote":"قائل ہونے میں کبھی جذبات کی کمی نہیں ہوتی۔"},{"location":"Paragraph 10","severity":"major","source_quote":"and report that God is in you of a truth","suggested_fix":"Change «واقعی خدا تمہارے درمیان ہے» to wording meaning «واقعی خدا تم میں ہے», preserving the source’s “in you” rather than “among you.”","translation_quote":"اور اقرار کرے گا کہ واقعی خدا تمہارے درمیان ہے"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
